source.name: Parotid Atlas anatomy scene (pipeline/build): slice.glb and frame.json

obligations: Acknowledge: Courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine (Visible Human Project)
Cite TotalSegmentator (Wasserthal et al.) and task papers
MPFB/MakeHuman assets are CC0 (no obligation; credited as courtesy)

attribution: Anatomy derived from the Visible Human Project male CT, courtesy of the U.S. National Library of Medicine; segmentations by TotalSegmentator; generic face, neck, shoulders and hair (and the opening's idealised portrait of them) from the MakeHuman/MPFB base mesh and targets (CC0); nerves, small vessels, deep-lobe completion and tumour authored to cited anatomy (pipeline/specs).
transformations: CT slices placed by GE header corners into one RAS volume (union grid)
marching cubes, Taubin smoothing, quadric decimation
authored retromandibular deep-lobe region; nerve-plane lobe split; baked peel field
gland cut into the ESGS levels and the extracapsular cuff (pieces.py), with baked cut-face, ink and mobilisation fields

schematic and illustrative meshes authored to specification: accessory lobe and duct, alternate tumour positions, auriculotemporal nerve and Frey regrowth, instruments (probe, needle, stimulator, drain), SMAS flap, neck-muscle strip, graft sheet, saliva collection, recurrence nodules, imaging planes

MPFB base mesh with MakeHuman's macro modifiers for a generic adult male (CC0 targets, ancestry mixed equally), fitted (per-axis scale, envelope and local conform) over the dissection field; the skin also covers the authored superficial nerves and veins

presentation only (no anatomy, no claims): exterior body (neck, shoulders, upper chest) cut from the same fitted MPFB surface below the scene cut; short hair and eyebrows as a root surface for shell rendering; a regional skin tint from MakeHuman target vertex sets; the superficial lobe's lateral footprint for the opening's localisation contour; per-vertex fibre directions for tissue structure (pipeline/anatomy/exterior.py, pipeline/build/export_gltf.py)

presentation only (no anatomy, no claims): the opening's portrait, a leaner and more muscular version of the same MPFB exterior (MakeHuman macro and feature targets, a torso turned and lowered under the profile head), stored as a per-vertex morph of the fitted skin, exterior body, eyes and hair root surface that settles into the fitted shape before any anatomy shows; its skin field (beard shadow, auricle, T-zone, scalp) and its haircut as a shell under-layer and an offline, seeded groom of ribbon cards (pipeline/anatomy/portrait.py, pipeline/anatomy/groom.py)
scene cut at z=150 mm; glTF export; meshopt compression and quantisation
